about_the_game:
The barrier separating realms has shattered, releasing a wave of accursed objects upon a distant kingdom. Each item, infused with either light's radiant energy or shadow's corruption, siphons life from everything it touches, leaving only ruin and the dead behind. Even the greatest mages cannot undo these hexes... Yet hope remains. Claire Darksage, a rogue bounty hunter and the final Elemental Harmonizer, possesses the unique ability to unite clashing energies. Only she can cleanse these objects and save the kingdom from their hold. Her already remarkable destiny is on the brink of transformation. Embark with Claire on a treacherous journey across blazing dunes, mystic groves, icy tundras, and fiery wastelands. Dominate inventive clashes against fearsome enemies. Outplay minstrels in strategic card games. Rally a band of vivid allies to challenge destiny itself. Unravel a tale riddled with secrets and shocking turns!

Features

  • 20 Hidden Object scenes: Search for objects of light and darkness in each scene!

  • Variety of challenging minigames.

  • Battles with novel gameplay and cards: Strategize to defeat Claire's enemies!

  • Adventure with an epic fantasy story.

  • Minstrels' challenge.

  • Darksage Temple: Purchase enhancements and powerful cards.

  • Find the Golden Skulls: Earn extra coins for your journey.

  • Secret Beast Eyes.

  • Hidden Object scenes and minigames offer replay value.

Customize difficulty and toggle story and tutorials.

Collector's Edition Bonuses

  • The Tower of Echoes: An additional mission featuring 8 extra Hidden Object levels.

  • Exclusive Minigames: Unique challenges not found in the standard edition.

  • 7 Wallpapers: Custom artwork for your desktop.

  • 20 Achievements: Prove your mastery of the game.

  • The Coliseum: Test your skills in extra battles!

  • 1 secret Hidden Object scene: Can you find it?

  • 1 secret Battle: Can you defeat this outlaw?
